description: This file implements system DNS configuration management for POSIX systems, including watching configuration files, reading DNS settings, and converting resolver state to DNS configuration objects.

classes.name: DnsConfigServicePosix::Watcher
classes.description: Watches DNS configuration and hosts file changes, manages callbacks for configuration updates.

classes.name: DnsConfigServicePosix::ConfigReader
classes.description: Reads DNS configuration asynchronously using libresolv and converts resolver state to DnsConfig.

methods.name: ReadDnsConfig
methods.description: Reads current DNS configuration by invoking resolver state and applying platform-specific checks.

methods.name: ConvertResStateToDnsConfig
methods.description: Converts resolver state structure to a DnsConfig object, validating options and name servers.
